name: pi-agent-gui
description: A tiny browser GUI backed by the pi SDK.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter client test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter client typecheck
scripts.format:check: cp client/src/components/chat/MessageView.tsx /tmp/MessageView.tsx && cp client/test/mobileOverflow.test.ts /tmp/mobileOverflow.test.ts && oxfmt client server && diff -u /tmp/MessageView.tsx client/src/components/chat/MessageView.tsx || true; diff -u /tmp/mobileOverflow.test.ts client/test/mobileOverflow.test.ts || true; false
